description: This file defines types, functions, and handlers for processing Slack modal interactions within a monitoring system, including session routing, event emission, and registration of modal handlers.

methods.name: resolveModalSessionRouting
methods.description: Resolves the session routing information based on metadata and context, determining session key, channel ID, and channel type.

methods.name: summarizeSlackViewLifecycleContext
methods.description: Summarizes the lifecycle context of a Slack view, extracting IDs and determining if the view is stacked.

methods.name: resolveSlackModalEventBase
methods.description: Constructs a base Slack modal event object from context, body, and view state.

methods.name: emitSlackModalLifecycleEvent
methods.description: Emits a Slack modal lifecycle event, handling logging, authorization, and event queuing.

methods.name: registerModalLifecycleHandler
methods.description: Registers a handler for Slack modal lifecycle events, with acknowledgment and filtering.
